_comment: Reference payload to register a custom AWS Bedrock endpoint via the API, bypassing the frontend's non-amazonaws.com URL rejection (the backend has no host whitelist on 0.13.0). POST to /api/models/. Replace every REPLACE_* token. Do NOT commit real credentials.
_shape_notes: external_endpoint MUST be a JSON-encoded string, not a nested object. The storage layer cannot insert dicts into model_config_kvs and returns 500 'can't adapt type dict'.
Use 'protocol' (not legacy 'service') for Bedrock chat — the chat handler dispatches on the protocol discriminator.
engine_name 'aws_bedrock' is the request-time discriminator. The server normalizes it to 'external_chat' on storage; both reads will show the normalized value.
The 'auth' block is a discriminated union. This example uses IAM. For Bedrock API Key (bearer), replace auth with: {"type":"bedrock_api_key","token":"REPLACE_BEDROCK_API_KEY"}.
'inference_profile_arn' is optional — include for cross-region inference profiles, omit otherwise.
'display_name' is optional UI label; safe to leave or remove.
name: bedrock-custom-endpoint
